nc.description: A 3D-rendered image displays a faceted grey housing with a central white cylinder, connected to a white rectangular block by a linkage arm and a strap wrapped around a circular hub.
A collection of light grey geometric shapes, including blocks, cylinders, and angled pieces, is arranged together on a white surface.
Three flat, light grey polygonal plates are interconnected by a central triangular framework of faceted struts and curved supports.
An abstract, light grey 3D rendering depicts a layered, bottle-like structure with multiple rectangular rods protruding outward from its narrow, collared end.
Various light grey mechanical components, including brackets, gears, springs, and plates, are arranged symmetrically around a central cylindrical object on a white background.

vc.description: A close-up view of a mechanical assembly shows a pedal-driven toothed belt mechanism next to a segmented tire and a vertical strut with a cutaway revealing an internal cylinder.
A mechanical device dispenses small round pellets from a channel that is connected by toothed belts to a pair of brake calipers.
A 3D model shows a roller chain routed through a framework of cylindrical tubes attached to a base plate.
A grey mechanical model featuring a scissor linkage, a knurled central cylinder, and parallel extending rods rests on a bell-shaped support against a white background.
A collection of unassembled mechanical parts, including a central gear assembly, levers, bearings, fasteners, and a track section, is neatly arranged on a plain white surface.
